cases.focus: a pack that is not a conforming document yields the pack-not-conformant evaluation error and no disposition; the fixture fails for one reason, a single outcome where two are required

an evidence-availability document carrying a member name the pack does not declare is malformed input; the pack is conforming and requires no extension, so no other class applies. The facts make the pack's applicability false, so an evaluator that resolves applicability before it has admitted the evidence document returns not-applicable here, where §8.2 requires the refusal first
a conforming pack that requires an extension the implementation does not support yields no disposition, because the unsupported part may be the part that decides
both pack-not-conformant and malformed-input apply, and the fixed order reports pack-not-conformant; this is the worked example in §8.4 made a row

both malformed-input and unsupported-required-extension apply, and the fixed order reports malformed-input; an implementation that checks extension support while reading the pack, before it looks at the evidence document, reports the wrong class here
